title: Death
stage: six-pose death prototype generated and reviewed; halo, continuity and alignment cleanup pending; not production approved

sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: Lanterns Underroot TAVI-018 death animation, individual game sprite PNG. Reference image is approved Tavi character turnaround, used only to lock identity and illustrated 2D rendering. Exactly the same boy: vivid cobalt blue tousled hair (never brown), warm peach skin (never blue), cream rolled-sleeve tunic, brown leather cross-body straps and belt pouch, red scarf, dark charcoal trousers, brown gloves and tall buckled leather boots, short sword sheathed at belt. Maintain costume, proportions, face and painterly clean outlined fantasy platformer style of reference. Full character, isolated on real transparent alpha; no background, ground shadow, text, panels, labels, borders, extra figures, silhouette copy or effects. Right-facing profile with slight three-quarter readability. Entire body, scarf and sword visible with generous empty padding. Non-graphic defeated animation, no injury or blood. One pose only. Frame 01 of 6: standing with knees slightly bent, shoulders slumped, head bowed, eyes closed, loose hands, beginning to collapse. IMPORTANT clean production cutout: fully opaque character pixels inside its contours, transparent pixels outside. Absolutely NO colored aura, bloom, glow, haze, vignette, rimlight, halo or cast shadow. Side-on view. Full body with 12% padding all around. Use landscape canvas 1536x1024 so every pose in this sequence uses identical framing.

review_notes: Identity colors match approved Tavi: blue hair, peach skin, cream tunic, red scarf.
Death/collapse poses delivered; no attack substitution.
Soft colored halos persist in poses 1–4 despite a correction attempt. Earlier drafts preserved.
Scale normalized by hair bounds; not tested in Godot. Runtime integration not requested.
export_provenance: derived by resampling and placing generated poses on common canvases; generated alpha preserved; silhouettes derived using alpha threshold
